campaigns.context: Large ClickFix/ClearFake wave on newly registered .beer and .sbs domains with script-themed names such as bootstrap-maxcdn.beer and capcha-cdn-js.beer. Enrichment cites 80+ domains used for fake CAPTCHA and browser verification lures. One reporter (TheM3gatr0n) flagged 190 IOCs on 2026-09-24.
campaigns.name: ClearFake/ClickFix fake CAPTCHA lures on .beer and .sbs domains

campaigns.context: Android malware is spread via scrambled-letter .com domains such as oiuwaksdiw.com, poiwaldsas.com and suwakdsdowa.com. Shared kit paths /point/download and /cash/downloadopwad impersonate Rakuten points and a cash benefit, while /nenkin/download and /ana impersonate Japan Pension Service and ANA airline. Reporter masaomi346 flagged these IOCs from 2026-09-19 to 2026-10-01.
campaigns.name: Japan Android malware on random-string .com domains

campaigns.context: Magecart web-skimming infrastructure uses domains that imitate analytics, CDN and security services, such as doubleclickpro.com, feedback-hotjar.com and captchatimestamp.com. Enrichment describes them as skimmer domains impersonating analytics and security services. Two reporters flagged 46 IOCs on 2026-09-26.
campaigns.name: Magecart skimmer infrastructure on fake analytics/CDN domains

campaigns.context: Adobe-themed phishing pages lead victims to ScreenConnect client installers, many on screenconnect.com tenant subdomains such as hl-ltd and manuelitellc, plus the .top domains leiber.top and swervimgbackj.top. Shared paths are /Bin/ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe and .msi. Reporters patialavii and smica83 flagged 40 IOCs from 2026-09-17 to 2026-10-16.
campaigns.name: Adobe-themed phishing delivering ScreenConnect RMM installer

campaigns.context: Attackers registered many domains following a report-[brand].com pattern, impersonating companies including Chase, Binance, Kraken, Marriott, Roblox and Gilead. Enrichment ties the pattern to ShinyHunters-style vishing that harvests Okta sessions. Three reporters flagged 38 IOCs from 2026-09-16 to 2026-09-28.
campaigns.name: ShinyHunters-style vishing on report-*.com brand lookalikes

campaigns.context: Phishing pages share a /login path across two lures: Roblox lookalikes such as https-roblox.com and www-robloxk.com, and iCloud clones such as account-icloud.hnxledu.com and account-icloud.cquup.com. The shared path is weak evidence of one operator. Four reporters flagged 27 IOCs from 2026-09-17 to 2026-10-15.
campaigns.name: Roblox and iCloud lookalike phishing sharing a /login path

campaigns.context: Random-label subdomains under onlinewebshop.net and wuaze.com are tagged C2 and Kimsuky. Enrichment ties both sets to the GitPower campaign, and one subdomain to a suspicious LNK file seen from South Korea. Three reporters flagged 26 IOCs from 2026-09-17 to 2026-10-16.
campaigns.name: Kimsuky GitPower C2 on free-hosting subdomains

campaigns.context: Numbered GitHub account and repository URLs such as f1-917, f3-917 and minercraft392 are tagged Kimsuky. Enrichment links them to DPRK payload staging and one .bat chain to Braodo Stealer, and notes a gist possibly used as a dead-drop resolver. Six reporters flagged 22 IOCs from 2026-09-17 to 2026-10-13.
campaigns.name: Kimsuky-tagged GitHub accounts staging payloads

campaigns.context: Subdomains of 5tr.org (vpn, dev, webconnect and others) and several IP addresses are tagged Vidar. Enrichment describes C2 IPs plus fake CAPTCHA, verification and CDN lure domains on abuse TLDs, some also linked to SmartLoader. Two reporters flagged 21 IOCs from 2026-10-08 to 2026-10-14.
campaigns.name: Vidar infostealer infrastructure on 5tr.org and abuse-TLD lures

campaigns.context: ClickFix-tagged lure domains on hyphenated .online names such as video-click.online, video-hostinger.online and video-wide.online. All were flagged on 2026-10-01 by one reporter (TheM3gatr0n) from a larger source list of ClickFix/pastejacking domains.
campaigns.name: ClickFix lure wave on hyphenated video-* .online domains

campaigns.context: An ngrok.app host serves MicrosoftUpdateServices.exe as a next stage after a malicious JS sample resembling XWorm. Tags name XWorm, AsyncRAT and #opendir; enrichment also cites fps.exe from ygz.bet and an open directory at 107.173.143.44. Three reporters flagged 14 IOCs from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-06.
campaigns.name: XWorm/AsyncRAT staging via ngrok and open directories

campaigns.context: Enrichment describes a phishing site at financeoakmont.com that impersonates an unnamed brand to push fast personal loan offers, with the action link pointing away from the displayed brand. One reporter (TKemmerling) flagged 14 IOCs from 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-29.
campaigns.name: Fast personal loan phishing via financeoakmont.com

campaigns.context: Six health-prefixed domains such as healthprimeflow.com, healthorazone.com and healthassistcarepro.com carry spam-style phishing lures, including a fake TOTAL Drive offer, a vision-test video and a Laura Geller sale. One reporter (TKemmerling) flagged 12 IOCs from 2026-09-19 to 2026-10-03.
campaigns.name: Health-themed phishing lures on health* domains

campaigns.context: Okta-themed look-alike root domains okta-linksso.com, okta-signinsso.com and okta-ssolink.com carry brand-named subdomains such as withpersona, rainxyz and appsflyer. Enrichment links them to suspected actor UNC6671 and says they were registered Oct 2 via NICENIC. Reporter SansLimit3 flagged 12 IOCs on 2026-10-08.
campaigns.name: Suspected UNC6671 SSO lookalike domains

campaigns.context: Phishing emails using MEDVi medication branding link to stylishhomegallery.com, which threat intelligence providers flag as malicious. One reporter (TKemmerling) flagged 12 IOCs from 2026-09-21 to 2026-10-06, all tagged #phishing.
campaigns.name: MEDVi-branded phishing email via stylishhomegallery.com

campaigns.context: A phishing lure branded as Empire Today flooring originates from immersionhousing.com and redirects victims to a data-collection form at missvalledeladrome.info, according to enrichment. One reporter (TKemmerling) flagged 12 IOCs from 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-12.
campaigns.name: Empire Today flooring-branded phishing via immersionhousing.com

campaigns.context: Canabit.ai and canabit.ca are tagged #cryptoscam and #scam. Enrichment cites an investment warning urging verification before committing funds. Both domains share the Canabit name and the same warning. Two reporters (Wilmichels, joshuaiancooper) flagged 12 IOCs from 2026-09-26 to 2026-10-16.
campaigns.name: Canabit crypto investment scam on .ai and .ca domains

campaigns.context: Enrichment describes malicious WordPress JavaScript injection infrastructure on wp-js.com subdomains such as stats, static, js, files and cdn, plus relay domains, with zero VirusTotal detections at report time. One reporter (500mk500) flagged 12 IOCs on 2026-09-16.
campaigns.name: wp-js.com WordPress JS injection infrastructure

campaigns.context: Google Sites pages under sites.google.com/view/ with random names, plus a Google Apps Script redirector, are tied by enrichment to Wazza Kit device-code phishing impersonating Adobe and Microsoft. A Google Play URL is described as an Anatsa banking trojan dropper, and a Google Docs drawing as a Japanese card-app lure. Four reporters flagged 11 IOCs.
campaigns.name: Google-hosted lures: Wazza Kit phishing and Anatsa dropper

campaigns.context: third-party.com hosts a fake Cloudflare CAPTCHA ClickFix lure that copies a malicious PowerShell command to the clipboard. Enrichment says the domain is hardcoded in over 1,700 GitHub repositories. Six reporters flagged 11 IOCs from 2026-09-23 to 2026-09-29.
campaigns.name: ClickFix CAPTCHA lure hardcoded into 1700+ GitHub repos

campaigns.context: Domain yscf988.club and several IP addresses are tagged ValleyRAT and described by enrichment as C2 servers in a Silver Fox campaign using DLL sideloading. Hashes are included. Four reporters flagged 11 IOCs from 2026-09-17 to 2026-10-13.

infra.org: AS55990 Huawei Cloud Service data center

net.org: AS55990 Huawei Cloud Service data center

campaigns.name: ValleyRAT C2 infrastructure linked to Silver Fox

campaigns.context: MioLab is a macOS infostealer, described by enrichment as delivered as Glaicer.dmg, with C2 at lewokodwqko.icu. All IOCs point to a single domain. One reporter (suyog41) flagged 10 IOCs from 2026-09-24 to 2026-10-08.
campaigns.name: MioLab macOS infostealer C2 at lewokodwqko.icu

campaigns.context: Enrichment describes an Americor-branded debt-relief email whose links go to the unrelated domain harborstonegroup.shop. One reporter (TKemmerling) flagged 10 IOCs from 2026-09-18 to 2026-10-14, all tagged #phishing.
campaigns.name: Americor-branded debt-relief phishing via harborstonegroup.shop

campaigns.context: Enrichment describes one phishing lure posing as cloud payment or renewal warnings that links to both wickerlookoutdoorfurniture.com and afromantic.com instead of an official service. campaigns.name: Cloud payment renewal phishing via afromantic.com and wickerlook domain

campaigns.context: Four .study domains and i0tjgjgm.xyz serve pages at the same /KnaeByNf/ path. Enrichment describes Docomo d Account impersonation aimed at Japanese users. Three reporters flagged 10 IOCs from 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-09.
campaigns.name: Docomo phishing on random .study/.xyz domains with /KnaeByNf path

campaigns.context: Four lookalike domains impersonate OpenAI: openai-credit.com, openai-credits.com, openai-bonus.com and openaaii.com. campaigns.name: OpenAI credits/bonus lookalike domains tagged ClickFix

campaigns.context: Azure cloudapp hostnames under eastus.cloudapp.azure.com serve an MSI (z5.msi), and enrichment notes an open directory and a sample spoofing a CrowdStrike user-agent. Family is not identified. One reporter (malwrhunterteam) flagged 8 IOCs from 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-13.
campaigns.name: MSI payload and open directory on Azure cloudapp hosts

campaigns.context: A bucket of file hashes attributed to AgentTesla. The grouping comes from enrichment, which describes Japanese-language invoice malspam with a RAR containing JS, Telegram API exfiltration, and a fake bank receipt MSI variant. No domains are present. Three reporters flagged 8 IOCs from 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-09.
campaigns.name: AgentTesla malspam samples with Japanese invoice lure

campaigns.context: Subdomains of proxy08.com named docsend, wechat, waaako and element act as C2 for the SONOMA macOS stealer, which enrichment says is delivered as fake DocSend, WeChat and Waaako installer DMGs. Two reporters flagged 8 IOCs from 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-09.
campaigns.name: SONOMA macOS stealer C2 on proxy08.com subdomains

campaigns.context: Four domains containing 'havan' (loja1-havan.com, lojas-havan.com, pagina-clientes-havan.com, site-google-havan.com) serve the same /produto/32812 fake product page. Enrichment describes a Brazilian clone of the Havan retailer used for phishing and payment fraud. One reporter (Coolcarlos17) flagged 8 IOCs from 2026-09-16 to 2026-10-13.
campaigns.name: Havan retailer clone shops on havan-named domains

campaigns.context: Nildex.com is tagged #cryptoscam and #scam. Enrichment says it was flagged as high-risk, with reports of withdrawal problems and extra requirements to move funds. All IOCs point to one domain. Two reporters flagged 6 IOCs from 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-13.
campaigns.name: Nildex.com crypto scam site

campaigns.context: Enrichment describes an Americor-style debt-relief lure sent from portfoliomoneyline.com that links to truenorthworks.fun, flagged by threat intelligence providers. Reporter TKemmerling flagged 6 IOCs from 2026-09-22 to 2026-10-15, all tagged #phishing.
campaigns.name: Bad credit lending phishing via truenorthworks.fun

campaigns.context: The domains inviteteamsmeeting.fit and teams-meeting-invite.icu host a /Teamsetup.msi installer under a Microsoft Teams meeting invite lure. Enrichment identifies the installer as an Atera RMM package. The hostnames embed the Teams brand and the filename mimics a legitimate Teams setup package. Reporter patialavii flagged 6 IOCs from 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-09.
campaigns.name: Fake Teams meeting invite delivering Teamsetup.msi

campaigns.context: Three domains, docsewallet.com, luxfab.luxe and strutsupportsystems.com, serve the same /Adobe_Installer.html path. Enrichment describes Adobe-themed pages delivering a ScreenConnect installer and, in one case, an OpsBridge RMM MSI. Kept apart from the ScreenConnect cluster because the path and domains differ. Reporter patialavii flagged 6 IOCs from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-16.
campaigns.name: Fake Adobe_Installer.html pages pushing RMM installers

campaigns.context: Subdomains of login-options.com carry brand names such as carlyle and aep. Enrichment attributes them to UNC6671 and describes investment management and US energy themes. Reporter PadelLifeUK flagged 6 IOCs on 2026-10-14.
campaigns.name: Brand-impersonation subdomains on login-options.com

campaigns.context: Random-label subdomains of xo.je serve a PHP endpoint tagged C2, APT and DPRK. Enrichment identifies it as a KONNI C2 URL on a free hosting domain and links a Korean-named defense-technology LNK lure. Two reporters flagged 5 IOCs from 2026-10-14 to 2026-10-15.
campaigns.name: KONNI C2 on xo.je free hosting subdomain

campaigns.context: Enrichment describes a Costco $500 winner lure hosted on crystalmnhomes.com and reached through a short link. The IOCs are the domain and its URLs, tagged #phishing. One reporter (TKemmerling) flagged 4 IOCs from 2026-10-08 to 2026-10-09.
campaigns.name: Costco $500 winner phishing via crystalmnhomes.com

campaigns.context: Enrichment describes Android malware impersonating the Japanese National Tax Agency and e-tax through fake emails and a phishing site at xuchangwuli-jp.com. Tags are #phishing and #malware. Two reporters (jm3xpf, masaomi346) flagged 4 IOCs from 2026-10-09 to 2026-10-10.
campaigns.name: Japan tax agency impersonation delivering Android malware

campaigns.context: Subdomains e1 and a2 of cdnresolver.com are tagged #stealer. Enrichment describes a Rust-based macOS infostealer distributed as DMG files (Zeff.dmg, Sayvora.dmg). The family label comes from enrichment. One reporter (suyog41) flagged 4 IOCs on 2026-10-09.
campaigns.name: macOS Rust stealer C2 on cdnresolver.com subdomains

campaigns.context: Two domains, jidianzz.com and nebuladialogue.top, serve pages at the same /sQwlMszY/ path. Enrichment describes impersonation of a Sumitomo Mitsui (SMBC) card aimed at Japanese users. One reporter (masaomi346) flagged 4 IOCs from 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-13, all tagged #phishing.
campaigns.name: Sumitomo Mitsui card phishing on jidianzz.com and nebuladialogue.top

campaigns.name: HYFLOCK ransomware leak blog on Tor

campaigns.context: Two .cfd domains, borshynel.cfd and branthoven.cfd, serve pages at the same /identifier/ path. Enrichment describes impersonation of Mitsubishi UFJ eSmart Securities to steal login credentials. Reporters masaomi346 and oroshi0064 flagged 4 IOCs from 2026-10-14 to 2026-10-15.
campaigns.name: Mitsubishi UFJ eSmart Securities phishing on .cfd domains

campaigns.name: AEON phishing on .cn domains with accoun subdomain

campaigns.context: Enrichment describes a phishing lure impersonating Endurance protection plans, sent from immersionhousing.com and linking to watermarkatgatewayplace.info. One reporter (TKemmerling) flagged 4 IOCs from 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-13, all tagged #phishing.
campaigns.name: Endurance protection plan phishing via watermarkatgatewayplace.info

campaigns.name: UNC6671 Microsoft OAuth lookalikes on myssologin.com

Enrichment tags one chain as PureLogs and names content.wordwalkers.co.nz as a download host; one summary describes an Amazon-themed lure. campaigns.context: auth.properties serves a URL with a microsoftonline mailbox upgrade path, tagged #phishing. Enrichment describes a Microsoft credential phishing page behind Cloudflare. The #ransomware tag looks generic. Reporters phishunt_io and scanmalware flagged 3 IOCs on 2026-10-14.
campaigns.name: Microsoft mailbox upgrade phishing on auth.properties
